limits: This is controlled bitstream coverage, not new encoder-native material.
All streams use one data point per frame and 32 QMF timeslots. Zero/two data points, other topologies and other runtimes were not added.
The 64-slot cases demonstrate carry and interruption, not an uninterrupted 64-step endpoint.
Native output multiplication is checked only in valid subbands 0..47; parameter values are expanded using the established mapping.
Metadata-only changes preserve PCM and A-JOC matrices; their raw native offset field and legacy scene coordinate do not establish absolute sample units.
The first-step, reciprocal multiplication and non-snapping runtime observations do not uniquely adjudicate the normative P17/P18 conflict.
Failed native processes and non-repeatable outputs are excluded even when partial observations or finite PCM exist.
